body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2TDvuJ2KygqHcBPtkDgePBK)_

**Base: `418-devonthink-search` (#418)**. Stack: #414 → #415 → #418 → #419 → #420. Docs only.

## What
- `docs/architecture/devonthink-emacs-integration.org` is deleted; its content is a bullet-point "Design" section of `docs/tangles/academic/sp-devonthink.org`, with a status table (which PR delivers which step) and a new "Open questions" list of everything still unclear or untested.
- Five ADRs, listed in `adr/README.org`: 0027 citekey joins BibTeX/litnote/DEVONthink; 0028 DEVONthink only through its scripting interface; 0029 litdb indexes only highlighted pages; 0030 two-way litnote and record link (proposed); 0031 the small `reading` database.
- Links to the old doc in the sibling module docs, `sp-litdb.org`, `devonthink-reading.org`, `sp-org-lint.org` and two architecture docs now point to `sp-devonthink.org`. Generated `dotfiles-prs/` and the CHANGELOG are untouched.

## Not tested
- Nothing to run; the tangle check passes.

## Manual testing
- [ ] Check out: `cd ~/dotfiles; git fetch origin 419-devonthink-design-adrs; git checkout 419-devonthink-design-adrs`.
- [ ] Open `~/.config/emacs-modular/docs/tangles/academic/sp-devonthink.org`: "Design" is the first section, then the module sections; everything is bullet lists or tables.
- [ ] `C-c C-o` on each of the five ADR links in the Design intro → each ADR opens.
- [ ] Read "Open questions": is anything missing or wrong? Tell me what to add.
- [ ] `ls ~/.config/emacs-modular/docs/architecture/` shows no `devonthink-emacs-integration.org`.
- [ ] Follow the "Design:" link at the top of `sp-devonthink-tags.org`, `sp-devonthink-browse.org`, `sp-devonthink-search.org`, `sp-litdb.org` and `devonthink-reading.org` → each lands in `sp-devonthink.org`.
- [ ] `cd ~/.config/emacs-modular; bash tools/check-tangle.sh` → "All tangled modules match their docs."
